status.current: watches the final with Hagun student council

relationships.stella-vermillion: Former selection opponent; judges that Dragon Spirit's power should let her defeat Ikki.
relationships.renren-tomaru: Argues with her over power versus speed.

periods.summary: Saijo accompanies the student council to Osaka and explains the venue crowds and outdoor screens. He predicts Stella will win because her Dragon Spirit and raw arm strength surpass what Ikki's technique can handle, prompting a heated power-versus-speed debate with Renren. He later watches the final and asks Toka for assessments of the fighters' condition.

key_events.summary: Explains the crowd situation and argues Stella's power is decisive.

periods.label: 蓄锐之斧破城舰

status.current: front-line student combatant against U.S. EDY robots

relationships.yuri-oreki: Fights under/alongside Oreki at Tokyo Bay.
relationships.renren-tomaru: Paired with Renren as the C-rank student response to EDY robots.

periods.summary: Ikazuchi is deployed to the Tokyo Bay front line because only C-rank-or-better student knights are used in the direct defense. When EDY robots pierce the line and destroy tanks with strong-particle cannons, Ikazuchi's charged Crescendo Axe smashes an EDY unit, proving that Hagun's stronger students can match America's mass-produced anti-knight weapons.

key_events.summary: Uses Crescendo Axe to break EDY robots after they disrupt the defense line.

periods.time: Tokyo Bay front line during PSYON breakthrough
periods.label: 破城舰救援失败

status.current: survives after being incapacitated by an Abraham clone
status.condition: electrocuted unconscious on the front line

relationships.renren-tomaru: Rushes in to save her after her leg is broken.
relationships.yuri-oreki: Teacher who witnesses his defeat and tries to stop PSYON.

periods.summary: Ikazuchi fights on the Tokyo Bay front and receives praise from self-defense soldiers for his raw power against EDY. When Renren is crushed by an Abraham clone, he attacks with his zanbato-like weapon, but the clone reads and avoids his blow, teleports behind him and knocks him out with electrokinesis. His defeat demonstrates how ordinary student strengths fail against PSYON's combination of foresight, teleportation and psychic power.

key_events.summary: Attempts to save Renren but is incapacitated by electrokinesis.
